messages:
Liam: Quick sync — postmortem action sweep + customer follow-ups. We have 4 open items from last outage that affect external messaging and one recurring pattern. Need owners + realistic timelines. Can everyone confirm sprint/owner? @Maria @Jordan @Sam
Maria: I can take the customer-facing note draft. First pass by today 17:00 PT. Need clarity on what to mark public vs internal.
Jordan: I'll take the status page edits. Quick q: do we avoid the phrase 'root cause' in external copy? Suggest 'primary cause identified' to be precise.
Sam: I'll run RCA-sharing constraints with Legal and Security. ETA tomorrow morning.
Alexa: Ops note — recurring spike pattern looks like memory growth in auth-worker. I pushed the initial signal and logs to the tracker.
incident-tracker-bot: Created checklist for thread 2460012345: 
1) External note draft
2) Status page update
3) RCA-sharing decision + template
4) Remediation owners + timelines
5) Recurrence analysis doc
See https://internal.redwood/incidents/2460012345 for artifacts.
Maria: Draft external note (first pass): 
```
We experienced degraded authentication responses between 08:12–08:47 UTC affecting a subset of customers. The primary cause identified: a memory leak in auth-worker that increased retry behavior and request queueing. A fix was deployed and service was verified as healthy.
```
Jordan: Good starting point. Recommend: 1) change 'primary cause identified' phrasing for clarity; 2) add a short 'what we're doing' action list; 3) include a link to the status page incident.
Sam: Legal confirms we can provide a summary RCA on request; full internal artifacts require account owner consent. I'll produce a template for RCA-sharing and opt-in language by 10:00 tomorrow.
Liam: OK owners/timelines summary: Maria — external note draft by today 17:00; Jordan — status page update by tomorrow 10:00; Sam — RCA-sharing template and policy by tomorrow 10:00; Alexa/ops — recurrence analysis + mitigation plan by Friday COB. Any objections?
Alexa: No objections. I'll attach timeline, relevant logs, and a list of related deploys to the recurrence doc.
Jordan: Also proposing a 'recurring-incidents' tag in the incident tracker so product/comms can query cross-incident patterns. I'll file the console change as a small ticket.
Maria: For the external note, can we add a short FAQ line: 'How will impacted customers be notified?' Proposed: "We will email impacted accounts, post updates on the status page, and provide an option to request the RCA summary."
Sam: +1 on the FAQ. I'll include the opt-in wording in the template.
Liam: I'll consolidate these into the action tracker and ping Product + Comms for a final read. If no blockers, I'll approve posting the external note after Maria's update. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jordan: :thumbsup:
